mapper.select: SELECT emp51_relate_appr_id AS relate_appr_id , emp51_company_id AS company_id , emp51_person_id AS person_id , emp51_yyyymm AS yyyymm , emp51_reg_no AS reg_no , emp51_reg_date AS reg_date , emp51_reg_amt AS reg_amt , emp51_appr_id AS appr_id , emp51_close_yn AS close_yn , CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp51_close_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '마감' ELSE '' END AS close_name , f_emp_kor_nm(emp51_person_id) AS person_name , f_get_empTrans(emp51_person_id, emp51_reg_date::date, 'pos_nm') AS pos_name , f_get_empTrans(emp51_person_id, emp51_reg_date::date, 'org_code_nm') AS org_name , apr01_status_cd AS status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, emp51_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS status_name , apr01_title AS appr_title , apr01_inout_cd AS inout_code FROM emp51_relate_appr LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr b ON emp51_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE emp51_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp51_yyyymm LIKE #{yyyymm} AND apr01_status_cd IN ('10', '20', '30') ORDER BY emp51_reg_no
